label: adjusted_close[t+6] / adjusted_close[t+1] - 1
a_universe: Native A-share stock codes and historical listing intervals; no current-survivor filter.
hk_universe: Frozen current-connect sample, bounded by listing intervals; user-accepted survivorship bias.
limitations: Five-session labels overlap; uncertainty uses HAC instead of independent-day standard errors.
Adjusted-price labels are theoretical price paths, not executable, cost-adjusted or currency-converted account returns.
Unavailable forward labels are counted, including delisting and source gaps; they are not assigned zero returns.
This is exploratory signal selection; no claim of monthly absolute returns or 15 percent risk compliance.
